recipe_version.title: South African Bobotie with Yellow Rice and Tomato Sambal
recipe_version.description: Cape Malay comfort food: gently curried ground beef baked with apricot jam, raisins, and milk-soaked bread under a golden savory egg custard studded with bay leaves. Served with turmeric-and-cinnamon yellow rice and a fresh tomato-onion sambal.

ingredients.name: yellow onions
ingredients.preparation: 1 diced for the filling, 1/2 finely diced for the sambal

ingredients.name: ground turmeric
ingredients.note: 1/2 tsp filling, 1/2 tsp custard, 1/2 tsp rice

ingredients.name: golden raisins
ingredients.note: 1/3 cup filling, the rest for the rice

ingredients.name: white sandwich bread
ingredients.display_name: slices store-bought white sandwich bread whose label lists no soy or sesame
ingredients.note: store-bought; required: the ingredient list shows no soy (including soy flour or soy lecithin) and no sesame

ingredients.name: whole milk
ingredients.note: 1/2 cup to soak the bread, 1 cup for the custard

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1 1/2 tsp filling, 1/4 tsp custard, 1/2 tsp rice, 1/4 tsp sambal

steps.title: Preheat and prep
steps.body: Turn the oven on to 350 F to preheat. Soak the torn bread in 1/2 cup milk. Dice the onions (one for the filling, half for the sambal) and mince the garlic. Seed and dice the tomatoes. Whisk the eggs with 1 cup milk, 1/2 tsp turmeric, and 1/4 tsp salt for the custard.

steps.title: Brown the filling
steps.body: Heat the oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium. Cook the filling onion until soft, 5 minutes; add the garlic, curry powder, and 1/2 tsp turmeric for 1 minute. Add the beef, 1 1/2 tsp salt, and the pepper and cook, breaking it up, until no pink remains, 8 minutes. Spoon off excess fat.

steps.title: Season and fill the dish
steps.body: Squeeze the bread lightly (keep the milk for the custard) and mash it into the beef with the apricot jam, 1/3 cup raisins, and 1 tbsp vinegar. Press into the baking dish and smooth the top. Whisk the squeezed-out milk into the custard and pour it over. Tuck the bay leaves upright into the surface.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake in the preheated 350 F oven until the custard is set, puffed, and golden at the edges, 35 minutes.

steps.title: Cook the yellow rice
steps.body: While the bobotie bakes, combine the rice, 2 1/4 cups water, 1/2 tsp turmeric, the cinnamon stick, the remaining raisins, and 1/2 tsp salt in a 2-quart saucepan. Boil, cover, cook on low 15 minutes, and rest covered 10. Runs inside step 4 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Make the sambal
steps.body: Toss the tomatoes with the sambal onion, 1 tbsp vinegar, the sugar, and 1/4 tsp salt. Runs inside step 4 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.body: Rest the bobotie 5 minutes, then cut into squares. Remove the cinnamon stick and fluff the rice. Serve with the sambal.
